name: KORG nanoKONTROL Studio

sources.title: QLC+ input profile KORG-nanoKONTROLStudio.qxi (non-official)
sources.note: community profile by Hans-Jürgen Tappe; Apache-2.0; numbers read from QLC+ channel numbers, not checked by this project

notes: Imported from QLC+. The messages are what its community profile lists; nobody has checked them on a unit for this project, so every control is unverified. QLC+ has no faceplate data, so the layout was generated from the list of controls and does not look like the device. QLC+ numbers these controls without a MIDI channel, so channel 1 here is a placeholder: the unit may send on another.
